$comment: Chaldean name numbers and name fit labels. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

blocks.name_number.1: A name that adds to 1 carries the Sun's vibration: it projects confidence, independence and leadership. People tend to see the bearer as capable and in charge.
blocks.name_number.2: A name that adds to 2 carries the Moon's vibration: gentle, cooperative and approachable. It draws people in and suits partnership and care.
blocks.name_number.3: A name that adds to 3 carries Jupiter's vibration: wise, respectable and expansive. It invites trust and suits teaching, advice and public life.
blocks.name_number.4: A name that adds to 4 carries Rahu's vibration: practical, original and unconventional. It suits technical and reform-minded work but can attract sudden changes.
blocks.name_number.5: A name that adds to 5 carries Mercury's vibration: lively, clever and sociable. It is one of the most popular business numbers and suits communication and trade.
blocks.name_number.6: A name that adds to 6 carries Venus's vibration: warm, attractive and harmonious. It suits creative work, family life and anything involving beauty or comfort.
blocks.name_number.7: A name that adds to 7 carries Ketu's vibration: thoughtful, private and insightful. It suits research and spiritual work; in business it may need a supportive Mulank.
blocks.name_number.8: A name that adds to 8 carries Saturn's vibration: serious, enduring and disciplined. It brings slow, solid results and is best used where the birth numbers are friendly to Saturn.
blocks.name_number.9: A name that adds to 9 carries Mars's vibration: energetic, courageous and determined. It suits leadership, sport and causes, and brings drive to whatever it names.
blocks.name_fit.supported: The name supports the birth numbers: its planet is friendly or neutral to both the Mulank and the Bhagyank, and the compound is not unfavourable. No change is needed.
blocks.name_fit.mixed: The name gives mixed support: one birth number welcomes it more than the other, or the compound needs care. A small spelling change could strengthen it.
blocks.name_fit.opposed: The name pulls against the birth numbers. Many people with such names do well, but a spelling change that brings the name in line with the Mulank and Bhagyank is worth considering.
blocks.name_number.1.daily: A name that adds to 1 carries the Sun's vibration of confidence and independence. People tend to see you as capable and in charge, and they may expect you to lead. Used every day, it supports self-belief and visibility, though it can make others assume you need no help.
blocks.name_number.1.work: At work this name suits leadership, management, government and your own business. It helps when you need to be noticed and trusted with decisions. In team roles, balance it with a warm manner so that confidence is not mistaken for distance.
blocks.name_number.1.using: Use the name consistently: on your signature, your business card and how you introduce yourself. Signing with a clear, rising stroke and without crossing through the name is a traditional practice for this number.
blocks.name_number.2.daily: A name that adds to 2 carries the Moon's vibration of gentleness and cooperation. People find you approachable and easy to confide in. Used every day, it supports partnerships and harmony, though it can soften your authority when you need to be firm.
blocks.name_number.2.work: At work this name suits counselling, care, hospitality, diplomacy and partnership roles. It is less forceful in sales or leadership, where you may need to state your views more directly to be heard.
blocks.name_number.2.using: Use the name in full on agreements and introductions. Partners and joint ventures tend to go well under this name; signing together with a trusted partner is in keeping with its nature.
blocks.name_number.3.daily: A name that adds to 3 carries Jupiter's vibration of wisdom, optimism and growth. People see you as knowledgeable and friendly, someone worth asking. Used every day, it supports learning, teaching and social ease, though it can scatter attention across too many interests.
blocks.name_number.3.work: At work this name suits education, law, finance, writing, consulting and public speaking. It helps you be heard and trusted for advice. Pair it with clear plans so that enthusiasm turns into results.
blocks.name_number.3.using: Use the name on certificates, publications and anything that builds your reputation. A signature written with a firm underline is a traditional support for this number.
blocks.name_number.4.daily: A name that adds to 4 carries Rahu's vibration of originality and practicality. People see you as different and dependable at once. Used every day, it supports technical skill and reform-minded work, though it can attract sudden changes and misunderstandings.
blocks.name_number.4.work: At work this name suits technology, engineering, research and systems. It is strong where method matters. In roles that depend on public goodwill, explain your ideas carefully, since your directness may surprise people.
blocks.name_number.4.using: Many numerologists suggest a small spelling change when a name adds to 4 and the birth numbers do not support it. The name correction section of this report shows options; check them with your numerologist before changing anything.
blocks.name_number.5.daily: A name that adds to 5 carries Mercury's vibration of quick thinking, communication and adaptability. People find you lively, clever and easy to talk to. Used every day, it supports trade, travel and networking, though it can bring restlessness.
blocks.name_number.5.work: At work this name suits sales, media, marketing, commerce, travel and any work with people and variety. It is one of the most commercially helpful vibrations. In long, routine roles it may feel restless; vary your tasks.
blocks.name_number.5.using: Use the name on business cards, websites and anything that reaches customers. Mercury favours clear, readable signatures and names that are easy to say and remember.
blocks.name_number.6.daily: A name that adds to 6 carries Venus's vibration of warmth, attraction and harmony. People feel comfortable with you and often trust you with family or personal matters. Used every day, it supports relationships, creative work and a happy home.
blocks.name_number.6.work: At work this name suits design, the arts, hospitality, beauty, healthcare, teaching and family businesses. It draws loyal clients. In tough negotiations, be clear about your terms so that pleasantness is not taken as agreement.
blocks.name_number.6.using: Use the name on anything connected with your home, family and creative work. A signature with a graceful, even flow is in keeping with Venus.
blocks.name_number.7.daily: A name that adds to 7 carries Ketu's vibration of insight, depth and detachment. People see you as thoughtful and perhaps reserved. Used every day, it supports research, spirituality and specialist skill, though it can make relationships and money feel slower.
blocks.name_number.7.work: At work this name suits research, analysis, healing, technology, writing and spiritual work. It is less helpful for mass-market sales. Let your expertise speak through your work and qualifications.
blocks.name_number.7.using: If your birth numbers do not support 7, the name correction section shows spellings to consider. Keep the name the same across documents you use every day, so its effect is consistent.
blocks.name_number.8.daily: A name that adds to 8 carries Saturn's vibration of discipline, responsibility and endurance. People take you seriously and trust you with long-term matters. Used every day, it supports steady authority and lasting results, though rewards may come slowly.
blocks.name_number.8.work: At work this name suits management, law, finance, property and large organisations. It builds lasting standing. Many numerologists treat 8 with caution for those whose birth numbers clash with Saturn; check the fit shown above.
blocks.name_number.8.using: If the fit with your birth numbers is weak, the name correction section shows alternatives. If it is strong, use the name consistently and with patience; Saturn rewards those who persist.
blocks.name_number.9.daily: A name that adds to 9 carries Mars's vibration of energy, courage and drive. People see you as bold, active and protective. Used every day, it supports leadership in difficult situations, sport and service, though it can bring conflict.
blocks.name_number.9.work: At work this name suits the forces, police, surgery, engineering, sport, property and humanitarian work. It helps you push through obstacles. Temper energy with patience in roles that need negotiation.
blocks.name_number.9.using: Use the name where courage and action are needed. A firm signature without sharp downward strokes is a traditional practice for this number.
